churches.enrichment_notes: [2026-09-10] Leadership and contact details taken verbatim from the church's own site (cfcwired.org), meet-the-team page: Brian Bales, Lead Pastor; Hector Aldaz, Lead Pastor Hispanic Ministry; Fred Clark, Pastor for Senior Adults; Jon Ackerman, Spiritual Development, Freedom Ministry & Men's Ministry Director; Beth Davidson, Community Life & Women's Ministry Director; Brooke Jones and Mike Haynes, Student Ministries; Alysia Metallo, Worship Director; Richele Walker, family ministries. Women serve as ministry directors, not as senior or lead pastor. Statement of faith is brief — Jesus the only Son of God, died and rose, salvation by faith in him — and is not a historic confession. No male-only-elder text is published on the site, so elder polity is undocumented rather than established either way. Denomination is not stated on the site and is left blank.
